```{r}
prs_scz2_0.1 <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/02.PRS/LDpred/SCZ2/03_validate/03_updateMap_all_chr_maf0.01_hwe_IDs_changed_noDup_scz2_filtered_PRS_LDpred_p1.0000e-01.txt", sep = ",", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, select = c("IID", "PRS"))
prs_scz2_0.01 <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/02.PRS/LDpred/SCZ2/03_validate/03_updateMap_all_chr_maf0.01_hwe_IDs_changed_noDup_scz2_filtered_PRS_LDpred_p1.0000e-02.txt", sep = ",", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, select = c("IID", "PRS"))
prs_scz2_0.001 <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/02.PRS/LDpred/SCZ2/03_validate/03_updateMap_all_chr_maf0.01_hwe_IDs_changed_noDup_scz2_filtered_PRS_LDpred_p1.0000e-02.txt", sep = ",", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, select = c("IID", "PRS"))  # somehow missing...
prs_scz2_0.3 <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/02.PRS/LDpred/SCZ2/03_validate/03_updateMap_all_chr_maf0.01_hwe_IDs_changed_noDup_scz2_filtered_PRS_LDpred_p3.0000e-01.txt", sep = ",", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, select = c("IID", "PRS"))
prs_scz2_0.03 <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/02.PRS/LDpred/SCZ2/03_validate/03_updateMap_all_chr_maf0.01_hwe_IDs_changed_noDup_scz2_filtered_PRS_LDpred_p3.0000e-02.txt", sep = ",", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, select = c("IID", "PRS"))
prs_scz2_0.003 <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/02.PRS/LDpred/SCZ2/03_validate/03_updateMap_all_chr_maf0.01_hwe_IDs_changed_noDup_scz2_filtered_PRS_LDpred_p3.0000e-03.txt", sep = ",", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, select = c("IID", "PRS"))
# Load phenotype data
load("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEX/RData_Files/4_affymetrix_exon_microarray_data_after_rma_core_gene_summaries_annotated_combat_batch_corrected.RData")
# filter data
index <- which(is.na(pData(geneSummaries)$C1))  # remove all samples with C1 = NA
geneSummaries <- geneSummaries[, -c(index)]
index <- which(is.na(pData(geneSummaries)$Type_of_Death))  # remove all samples with Type_of_Death = NA
geneSummaries <- geneSummaries[, -c(index)]
dim(geneSummaries)
# save phenotype data
pData <- pData(geneSummaries)
# Merge all PRS into one dataframe
prs_scz <- cbind(prs_scz2_inf$PRS, prs_scz2_1$PRS, prs_scz2_0.3$PRS, prs_scz2_0.1$PRS, prs_scz2_0.03$PRS, prs_scz2_0.01$PRS, prs_scz2_0.003$PRS, prs_scz2_0.001$PRS)
rownames(prs_scz) <- prs_scz2_inf$IID
prs_scz <- prs_scz[row.names(prs_scz) %in% pData$IID, ]
colnames(prs_scz) <- c("PRS_inf", "PRS_1", "PRS_0.3", "PRS_0.1", "PRS_0.03", "PRS_0.01", "PR_0.003", "PRS_0.001")
```

## Generate corrplot of different thetas

```{r}
# add Dx
prs_scz <- merge(prs_scz, mapping, by.x = "row.names", by.y = "IID", all.x = T)
prs_scz$Dx <- as.character(prs_scz$Dx)
prs_scz[as.character(prs_scz$Dx) == "CTL", "Dx"] <- 0
prs_scz[as.character(prs_scz$Dx) == "SCZ", "Dx"] <- 1
prs_scz$Dx <- as.numeric(prs_scz$Dx)
row.names(prs_scz) <- prs_scz$Row.names
prs_scz$Row.names <- NULL

png("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/02.PRS/figures/corrplot_pearson_cor_SCZ2_PRS_different_thetas.png", type = "cairo")
res <- cor(prs_scz)  # generate correlation matrix
corrplot(res, method = "circle", col = viridis(200, direction = -1))  # generate correlation plot
dev.off()
```

## Check association to Dx

```{r}
prs_scz$Dx <- NULL
prs_scz <- t(prs_scz)
mapping <- pData[, c("IID", "Dx")]
mapping[mapping$Dx == "BPD" | mapping$Dx == "MDD", "Dx"] <- "SCZ" # change BPD and MDD to SCZ
# relevel disease (Dx) to control (CTL)
mapping$Dx <- factor(mapping$Dx, levels = c("CTL", "SCZ"))
rownames(mapping) <- mapping$IID
# generate design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ Dx, mapping)
head(design)
# get top DE genes
fit <- lmFit(prs_scz, design)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit)
top.hits <- topTable(fit2, coef = "DxSCZ")
top.hits
```


# Load data

We first need to load the PRS LDpred-inf scores. Remember to add a comma "," at the end of the header line (or remove all commas from the rest of the lines) otherwise read.table or fread can not read in the data correctly. 

```{r echo = F}
# load SCZ2 PRS
prs.scz2 <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/genotype_data/3_LDpred/SCZ2/03_validate/pmb_info06_all_chr_merged_scz2_filtered_PRS_LDpred-inf.txt", sep = ",", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, select = c("IID", "true_phens", "raw_effects_prs", "pval_derived_effects_prs"))
# load MDD2 PRS
prs.mdd2 <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/genotype_data/3_LDpred/MDD2/03_validate/pmb_info06_all_chr_merged_mdd2_filtered_PRS_LDpred-inf.txt", sep = ",", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, select = c("IID", "true_phens", "raw_effects_prs", "pval_derived_effects_prs"))
# load BIP-2018 PRS

# load ADHD-2017
prs.adhd <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/genotype_data/3_LDpred/ADHD-2017/03_validate/pmb_info06_all_chr_merged_adhd_filtered_PRS_LDpred-inf.txt", sep = ",", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, select = c("IID", "true_phens", "raw_effects_prs", "pval_derived_effects_prs"))
#load ASD
prs.asd <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/genotype_data/3_LDpred/ASD/03_validate/pmb_info06_all_chr_merged_asd_filtered_PRS_LDpred-inf.txt", sep = ",", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, select = c("IID", "true_phens", "raw_effects_prs", "pval_derived_effects_prs"))
prs.bip.vs.scz <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/genotype_data/3_LDpred/BIPvsSCZ/03_validate/pmb_info06_all_chr_merged_bd_vs_scz_filtered_PRS_LDpred-inf.txt", sep = ",", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, select = c("IID", "true_phens", "raw_effects_prs", "pval_derived_effects_prs"))
prs.bip.scz.vs.ctl <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/genotype_data/3_LDpred/BIP+SCZvsCONT/03_validate/pmb_info06_all_chr_merged_bd_scz_vs_cont_filtered_PRS_LDpred-inf.txt", sep = ",", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, select = c("IID", "true_phens", "raw_effects_prs", "pval_derived_effects_prs"))
# load phenotype file
prs.ea <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/genotype_data/3_LDpred/EA/03_validate/pmb_info06_all_chr_merged_ea_filtered_PRS_LDpred-inf.txt", sep = ",", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, select = c("IID", "true_phens", "raw_effects_prs", "pval_derived_effects_prs"))
prs.cross.disorder <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/genotype_data/3_LDpred/Cross_Disorder/03_validate/pmb_info06_all_chr_merged_cross_disorder_filtered_PRS_LDpred-inf.txt", sep = ",", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, select = c("IID", "true_phens", "raw_effects_prs", "pval_derived_effects_prs"))
gr.score <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/genotype_data/4_TRPS/03_TRPS.txt", sep = "\t", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, select = c("IID", "gr_score"))
gr.score <- gr.score[!startsWith(gr.score$IID, "MD") & !endsWith(gr.score$IID, "ZNP")]
gr.score <- gr.score[gr.score$IID %in% pData$IID]
```

# Plots

```{r}
# load data
prs.scz2 <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/02.PRS/test/03_updateMap_all_chr_maf0.01_hwe_IDs_changed_noDup_scz2_filtered_PRS_LDpred_p1.0000e+00.txt", sep = ",", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
# Add diagnosis column to the PRS
prs.scz2 <- merge(prs.scz2, pData, by = "IID", all.x = T)
head(prs.scz2)
# get six colors (for plots)
col <- viridis(20)
prs.scz2 <- as.data.frame(prs.scz2)
prs.scz2$Dx <- as.factor(prs.scz2$Dx)
prs.scz2$Dx <- factor(prs.scz2$Dx, levels = c("CTL", "MDD", "BPD", "SCZ"))
prs.scz2$PRS <- as.numeric(prs.scz2$PRS)
ggplot(prs.scz2, aes(x = Dx, y = PRS, fill = Dx)) + 
  geom_boxplot() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(col[3], col[6], col[11], col[17]), name = "Diagnosis") +
  ggtitle("PRS based on SCZ2 summary statistic") + 
  ylab("p-value derived effect prs") +
  theme_grey(base_size = 18) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.75), axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_text(size=20))
```



### Correlation Plot

```{r, echo = F}
# 1. Load expression dataset + phenotype data
load("/home/karolina/Desktop/PhD/MPIP/workspace/RData_Files/4_affymetrix_exon_microarray_data_after_rma_gene_summaries_annotated_combat_batch_corrected.RData")
head(pData)
# 2. Save only important columns of pData and add PRS
pData <- pData[, c("IID", "Age", "Sex", "Dx", "pH", "PMI", "Suicide", "RIN", "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4")]
pData$RIN2 <- pData$RIN^2
# 3. Add PRS for different summary statistic files to pData
prs.scz2 <- data.frame(IID = prs.scz2$IID, PRS_SCZ2 = prs.scz2$pval_derived_effects_prs)
pData <- merge(pData, prs.scz2, by = "IID", all.x = T)
prs.mdd2 <- data.frame(IID = prs.mdd2$IID, PRS_MDD2 = prs.mdd2$pval_derived_effects_prs)
pData <- merge(pData, prs.mdd2, by = "IID", all.x = T)
prs.bip <- data.frame(IID = prs.bip$IID, PRS_BIP = prs.bip$pval_derived_effects_prs)
pData <- merge(pData, prs.bip, by = "IID", all.x = T)
prs.adhd <- data.frame(IID = prs.adhd$IID, PRS_ADHD = prs.adhd$pval_derived_effects_prs)
pData <- merge(pData, prs.adhd, by = "IID", all.x = T)
prs.asd <- data.frame(IID = prs.asd$IID, PRS_ASD = prs.asd$pval_derived_effects_prs)
pData <- merge(pData, prs.asd, by = "IID", all.x = T)
prs.bip.vs.scz <- data.frame(IID = prs.bip.vs.scz$IID, PRS_BIPvsSCZ = prs.bip.vs.scz$pval_derived_effects_prs)
pData <- merge(pData, prs.bip.vs.scz, by = "IID", all.x = T)
prs.bip.scz.vs.ctl <- data.frame(IID = prs.bip.scz.vs.ctl$IID, PRS_BIPSCZvsCTL = prs.bip.scz.vs.ctl$pval_derived_effects_prs)
pData <- merge(pData, prs.bip.scz.vs.ctl, by = "IID", all.x = T)
prs.gr.score <- data.frame(IID = prs.gr.score$IID, PRS_GRScore = prs.gr.score$gr_score)
pData <- merge(pData, prs.gr.score, by = "IID", all.x = T)
prs.ea <- data.frame(IID = prs.ea$IID, PRS_EA = prs.ea$pval_derived_effects_prs)
pData <- merge(pData, prs.ea, by = "IID", all.x = T)
prs.cd <- data.frame(IID = prs.cd$IID, PRS_CD = prs.cd$pval_derived_effects_prs)
pData <- merge(pData, prs.cd, by = "IID", all.x = T)
# 4. Remove all rows including an NA in any column and remove the IID column (NOT needed for the corrplot!)
pData.new <- pData[complete.cases(pData),]
pData.new$IID <- NULL
# 5. change BPD and MDD diagnosis in Dx to SCZ
pData.new$Dx <- as.character(pData.new$Dx)  # change factor column to character
pData.new[pData.new$Dx == "BPD" | pData.new$Dx == "MDD", "Dx"] <- "SCZ"  # change BPD and MDD to SCZ
pData.new[, c("Sex", "Dx", "Suicide")] <- lapply(pData.new[, c("Sex", "Dx", "Suicide")], factor)
#sapply(pData.new, class) # check type of columns
# relevel disease (Dx) to control (CTL)
pData.new$Dx <- factor(pData.new$Dx, levels = c("CTL", "SCZ"))
# save categorical and continuous variable names
classes <- sapply(pData.new, class) # get type of columns
categorical.cov = names(classes[classes == "factor"])
continuous.cov = names(classes[classes == "numeric"])
# generate contrast for design matrix
contrast <- lapply(categorical.cov, function(x) {fac = pData.new[, x]; return(contrasts(fac))})
names(contrast) <- categorical.cov
# generate design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ . + Age + Sex + Dx + pH + PMI + Suicide + RIN + RIN2 + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + PRS_SCZ2 + PRS_MDD2 + PRS_BIP + PRS_ADHD + PRS_ASD + PRS_BIPvsSCZ + PRS_BIPSCZvsCTL + PRS_GRScore + PRS_EA + PRS_CD, pData.new, contrasts.arg = contrast)
design.cor <- corr.test(design[, -1], use='pairwise.complete.obs', method = "pearson", adjust = "none")
corrplot(design.cor$r, method = "circle", col = viridis(200, direction = -1))
# generate design matrix
pData.new <- pData.new[, c("PRS_SCZ2", "PRS_MDD2", "PRS_BIP", "PRS_ADHD", "PRS_ASD", "PRS_BIPvsSCZ", "PRS_BIPSCZvsCTL", "PRS_GRScore", "PRS_EA", "PRS_CD")]
design <- model.matrix(~ . + PRS_SCZ2 + PRS_MDD2 + PRS_BIP + PRS_ADHD + PRS_ASD + PRS_BIPvsSCZ + PRS_BIPSCZvsCTL + PRS_GRScore + PRS_EA + PRS_CD, pData.new, contrasts.arg = contrast)
design
design.cor <- corr.test(design[, -1], use='pairwise.complete.obs', method = "pearson", adjust = "none")
corrplot(design.cor$r, method = "circle", col = viridis(200, direction = -1))
```


### Heatmap (Patients vs. PRScores)

Für alle PRS:

```{r, echo = F}
# save only IID and PRS columns
pData.new <- pData[, c("IID", "PRS_SCZ2", "PRS_MDD2", "PRS_BIP", "PRS_ADHD", "PRS_ASD", "PRS_BIPSCZvsCTL", "PRS_GRScore", "PRS_EA", "PRS_CD")]
# Remove all rows including an NA in any column and remove the IID column 
pData.new <- pData.new[complete.cases(pData.new),]
# set IIDs as rownames and remove IID column afterwards
row.names(pData.new) <- pData.new$IID
pData.new$IID <- NULL
# generate heatmap
samples <- as.data.frame(pData[, c("IID", "Dx")])
samples <- samples[complete.cases(samples),]
row.names(samples) <- samples$IID
samples$IID <- NULL
ann_colors = list(Dx = c(SCZ = viridis(20)[2], BPD = viridis(20)[6], MDD = viridis(20)[14], CTL = viridis(20)[19]))
pheatmap(t(pData.new), scale = "row", annotation_col = samples, annotation_colors = ann_colors) #, color = viridis(200))
```
